subject: MSA/Order Form: insurance evidence & naming for additional insured
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: contracts@acme-industries.com, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-industries.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA/Order Form: insurance evidence & naming for additional insured

Hi Jane / Acme Contracts team,

Thanks for sending the latest MSA and order form. We've reviewed the insurance section and attached a short set of redlines to accelerate legal review (attachment: redlines_MSA_v3.pdf - PDF). To keep procurement moving, can you confirm the following items so we can provide the certificate and endorsement quickly:

- Coverage minimums you require by policy (we currently have standard limits to propose: GL 1,000,000/2,000,000; Auto 1,000,000; Professional/Errors & Omissions 2,000,000; Cyber/Tech E&O 5,000,000).
- Exact entity(ies) to be named as Additional Insured (company-level vs. specific subsidiaries).
- Whether Acme requires ISO additional insured endorsement wording or an equivalent tailored endorsement.
- Any policy form or endorsement number you need (e.g., CG 20 10 / CG 20 37 styles).

We can produce a Certificate of Insurance (COI) and an Additional Insured endorsement from our broker within 3–5 business days once the naming and wording are confirmed. For operational clarity, if Acme needs waiver of subrogation or 30-day cancellation notice, please confirm.

Copying Stephanie and Laura from our deals/legal team to help finalize.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redlines_MSA_v3.pdf - PDF)

From: Acme Contracts <contracts@acme-industries.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-industries.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form: insurance evidence & naming for additional insured

Karthik,

Thanks — we received your redlines. A few clarifications from our side:

- Required minimum limits (our standard): General Liability 1,000,000 per occurrence / 2,000,000 aggregate; Auto 1,000,000 combined single limit; Professional Liability (E&O) 2,000,000; Cyber/Privacy liability 5,000,000.
- Additional Insured: Please name “Acme Industries, Inc., and its subsidiaries and affiliates” as Additional Insureds. We can provide a short list of subsidiaries if that helps — I'll attach our naming template.
- Endorsement: We ask for additional insured endorsement on a primary and non-contributory basis to the extent allowed by law. Exact ISO form number is not mandatory, but equivalent wording required.
- Cancellation: 30 days notice preferred; 10 days for non-payment is acceptable.

Attaching our COI request template for your broker (attachment: acme_coi_request_template.pdf - PDF). Also looping in our broker, Oliver Smith, who will coordinate the endorsement language if needed.

Jane Doe
Contracts Manager, Acme Industries
(attachment: acme_coi_request_template.pdf - PDF)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-industries.com>, Acme Contracts <contracts@acme-industries.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@acme-broker.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form: insurance evidence & naming for additional insured

Jane / team — appreciate the template and details. Quick responses to your bullets and a proposed path forward: 

- Limits: the limits you listed are acceptable from our side; we'll confirm with our broker but anticipate meeting those.
- Additional Insured naming: we are comfortable naming “Acme Industries, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates listed on the order form” as Additional Insureds, limited to liability arising out of Redwood’s performance. If you can send the short list of subsidiaries you mentioned, we'll ensure they’re included on the endorsement.
- Endorsement wording: we can provide an ISO-equivalent Additional Insured endorsement that is primary and non-contributory to the extent permitted by law. If Acme needs a specific ISO form number, please confirm; otherwise our broker will issue a commonly accepted endorsement form.
- Cancellation notice: we can accept 30 days notice for cancellation and 10 days for non-payment — we will request the carrier to reflect that on the COI if possible.

Next steps:
1) I'll ask our broker to prepare the COI and the sample Additional Insured endorsement.
2) Oliver (cc) — if you can coordinate with our broker (details below), they can exchange draft endorsement language.
3) We expect to produce a signed COI + endorsement within 3 business days of final naming confirmation and broker coordination.

Attachment: sample_endorsement.pdf (sample language from our broker).

Thanks — please advise if that timeline works.

Regards,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: sample_endorsement.pdf - PDF)

From: Acme Contracts <contracts@acme-industries.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@acme-broker.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-industries.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form: insurance evidence & naming for additional insured

Karthik — this is perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. Oliver, please coordinate with Redwood’s broker and share the draft endorsement. Jane and I will send the subsidiary list this afternoon. Once we have the COI and endorsement we’ll mark the insurance item closed on our side and proceed to countersign.

Timeline notes for the record: Acme expects receipt of COI + endorsement within 5 business days; if Redwood needs more time, flag immediately and we can discuss interim remedies (e.g., escrow of limited funds).

Thanks,
Acme Contracts Team
Acme Industries
(attachments: none)
